statusDetail: DataDome/PRISA Media anti-bot interstitial prevented access to the target experience. This is an evidence/recon attempt, not a completed audit.

page.notes: Target page architecture could not be identified because browser navigation was replaced by a DataDome device-check iframe. Raw fetch returned substantial HTML, but the browser surface required for representative multimodal and interaction testing remained unavailable.
